Survey hundreds of medical datasets
public sources plus approved hospital data
span image modalities and clinical specialties

Filter for usable high-quality labels
retain 284 datasets
268 public + 16 ethically approved hospital sets

Standardize images and label expressions
convert heterogeneous medical inputs for display
normalize ambiguous or duplicate label wording

Organize a customizable lexical tree
38 modalities · 18 clinical tasks
18 departments · 4 perceptual granularities

Form local-view question and option pools
group by modality × task × granularity
require all three cues in each question

Generate candidate VQA pairs
sample one question and up to four options
pair the medical image with its grounded answer

Manually reject invalid questions
missing key cues or answerable without image
incorrect answer · unclear target · poor image

Select diverse cases per answer
cap at 30 while varying appearance and source
consider age, gender, and other relevant factors

Assemble 25,831 VQA pairs
validation: 4,550 · test: 21,281
withhold test answers for organizer evaluation

Run LVLMs zero-shot via VLMEvalKit
extract the selected option or answer
report accuracy overall and by lexical-tree slice
